description: Elections Commission - B. M.  Dharmasena Bamunusingha of the Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - N. P. T. G. B. Nelundeniya of the Udubaddawa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as Members of Pradeshiya Sabhas due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating of offices and election-related declarations.
